description: This Java source file defines the PayPalAuthorizationProvider class, which implements the PaymentAuthorizationProvider interface. It handles the process of authorizing payments via PayPal by creating an order, authorizing it, and managing related API interactions, including token retrieval, request handling, and response parsing.

classes.name: PayPalAuthorizationProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to authorize PayPal transactions using OAuth2 tokens, create and authorize orders with PayPal orders v2 API, and logs the process for debugging and traceability.

methods.name: provider
methods.description: Returns the associated PaymentProvider enum value, PAYPAL.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Main method to perform PayPal authorization workflow: obtains access token, creates order, authorizes the order, and returns the result encapsulating order and authorization IDs along with raw responses.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuth2 access token from PayPal using client credentials.

methods.name: safeJson
methods.description: Utility method that safely encloses raw responses into JSON-formatted strings for storage and traceability.
